dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.macro_annuli_edge_geometry: A series of interconnected 'O' and 'C' shaped light-grey patterns with irregular, serrated outer perimeters. The transition from the dark background to the lighter interior of these rings is sharp, defined by a rapid intensity gradient concentrated at the edge boundaries in the central-dorsal region.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.high_intensity_blob_density: Moderate density of localized, high-intensity white pixel clusters lacking internal gradients. These blobs are primarily scattered in the interstitial spaces between macro-annuli, with a higher concentration observed in the posterior-dorsal quadrant.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.constellation_keypoints: The centroids of three large, distinct macro-annuli in the mid-lateral section form an obtuse triangle. A secondary, nearly linear arrangement of high-intensity blobs is visible along the dorsal ridge line, forming a chain of four distinct points.

other_distinctive_markers: Presence of three vertical, high-aspect-ratio green-hued features (out-of-focus vegetation) occluding the lower-central pixel region of the subject body.
